theater: 長江瓜步至京口白土岡

battle.name: 白土崗之戰
battle.theater: 長江瓜步至京口白土岡
battle.brief: 開皇九年（589）正月，隋滅陳之役：韓擒虎夜襲采石，賀若弼自廣陵濟江、沿江北岸西進，與陳將蕭摩訶戰於京口西白土岡，陳軍大潰。科林斯青銅盔屬希臘青銅時代工藝，早於本役千餘年，不在現場；隋軍靠騎兵縱隊與旗幟節制推進，陳軍一散即無從結陣，「戴盔者只能靠隊形活」一語在開皇九年的印證。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 開皇九年（589）正月，隋文帝楊堅調兵四道滅陳，戰線自長江上游到江淮同時展開。淮南一路以晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，駐廣陵（揚州）節制諸軍，長史高頎總督糧秣；淮東一路由賀若弼自廣陵濟江，沿長江北岸西取京口，再趨建康；西南一路由韓擒虎率精兵夜渡大江，直取采石；荊襄方向由秦王楊俊出襄陽、鄂州道王皐進取湘州，使陳朝南北兩翼同時受壓，四路大軍互為犄角，陳朝倚以為屏障的三防格局被拆成數段。陳方的指揮中樞在建康，後主陳叔寶以侍中蔡大寶掌機要、尚書僕射施文慶理軍政，兵權交在虎威將軍蕭摩訶與各州鎮守將領手中，采石一線由都督杜彥領兵固守。南北兩朝在兵制上同出五胡亂華之後，隋以關洛為本、兼收江南降兵與水軍，陳則倚江自守、以舟師和弩防為主，兩軍在爭奪長江渡口時，完全以腳力與舟具的對比見輸贏。
countriesEn: In the first month of 589, Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, mustered troops on four axes to destroy Chen, and the war unfolded at once from the upper Yangtze to the Jianghuai region. On the Huainan axis the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, served as supreme commander, headquartered at Guangling (Yangzhou) and controlled all the armies, with his chief of staff Gao Qiao overseeing grain and provisions. On the eastern axis He Ruobi crossed the river from Guangling and marched west along the north bank of the Yangtze to take Jingdu and then move on Jiankang. On the southwestern axis Han Qinhu led picked troops across the great river by night and struck straight at Caishi. On the Jingxiang axis the Prince of Qin, Yang Jun, moved out from Xiangyang, while Wang Gao advanced through Ezhou toward Xiangzhou. The Chen state was thus pressed on both its northern and southern wings, and the four columns served as mutual supports, breaking the three-fold defence line on which Chen had relied into separate fragments. The Chen command centre lay at Jiankang. The last emperor, Chen Shubao, handled state affairs through Cai Dabao, who served as director of the palace, and Shi Wenqing, the director of the imperial secretariat, while the actual command of troops rested with the Tiger Might General Xiao Mohe and the garrison commanders of the various prefectures; the line at Caishi was held by the commander Du Yan. Both states had inherited their military systems from the chaos of the late Han and the Five Barbarians. Sui drew on Guanzhong and Luoyang as its base and additionally took in surrendered southern troops and river units, whereas Chen defended itself against the river, relying on its fleet and on crossbow fire. When the two sides fought for the crossings of the Yangtze, the outcome was settled entirely by the comparison between the marching strength of the infantry and the size of the river craft.
people: 隋文帝楊堅是這場戰爭的決策者，他把平陳交給次子晉王楊廣全權節制，卻同時保留制衡：糧秣、人事、賞罰各有分屬，行軍元帥只管前線。楊廣坐鎮廣陵，造舟、徵糧、操練水軍，把這場戰爭做成一次以工程與後勤為骨架的行動。真正決定江面勝負的兩個人，一個是賀若弼，一個是韓擒虎：賀若弼主淮東，選擇正面渡江、沿北岸壓進的穩重一路；韓擒虎主西南，選夜渡、奇襲的險一路，兩人出發前已約定同時發動，令陳軍首尾不能相顧。陳方最被倚重的是蕭摩訶，陳人稱其驍勇，白土岡一役他親率精兵拒守卻遭隋軍騎兵縱隊掩殺，僅以身免，此役之後陳朝再無可以獨當一面的將領。采石守將杜彥在隋軍夜襲中兵敗身亡，陳朝因此失去長江防線西端的支點。後主陳叔寶在事前聽從遷都建康以避兵鋒之請的施文慶被拒，守城良策屢屢被否；蔡大寶與施文慶留守建康，張麗華與孔貴嬪則隨侍後主直至臺城失守。蕭摩訶後來降隋，得授開府儀同三司；賀若弼封廣陽郡公，韓擒虎封鄭國公，平陳之功的分配，在隋朝內部很快變成另一場政治風波。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the man who decided this war. He handed the destruction of Chen over to his second son, the Prince of Jin Yang Guang, with full operational control, while retaining checks of his own: provisions, appointments and rewards were each kept in separate hands, and the supreme commander was responsible only for the front. Yang Guang sat at Guangling building boats, requisitioning grain and drilling his river troops, turning the campaign into an action whose skeleton was engineering and logistics. Two men actually decided the contest on the river, He Ruobi and Han Qinhu. He Ruobi took the eastern axis and chose the measured route of crossing in daylight and pressing along the north bank; Han Qinhu took the southwest and chose the risky route of a night crossing and a surprise attack. Before they set out the two had already agreed to strike simultaneously, so that the Chen forces could not watch one end and the other at the same time. The man Chen relied on most was Xiao Mohe, whose valour his own people praised; at the fight on the White Earth Ridge he led picked troops in person and was swept away by the Sui cavalry columns, escaping with his life alone, and after this battle Chen had no commander left who could hold a front on his own. Du Yan, the defender of Caishi, was killed when the Sui night attack broke his line, and Chen thereby lost the hinge at the western end of its river defence. The last emperor, Chen Shubao, had earlier rejected the request of Shi Wenqing to move the capital eastward and avoid the Sui advance, and sound defensive measures were refused again and again. Cai Dabao and Shi Wenqing stayed behind at Jiankang, while Zhang Lihua and Kong Guiguin remained with the emperor until the fall of the imperial terraces. Xiao Mohe later surrendered to Sui and was granted the rank of a minister of the palace. He Ruobi was made Duke of Guangyang, Han Qinhu Duke of Zheng, and the division of the credit for the conquest quickly became another political current inside the Sui court.
kits: 這張卡面的科林斯青銅盔是希臘青銅時代的重裝步兵頭盔，全正面開眼、罩住頭頸兩側，視野狹窄，代價是戴盔的人幾乎看不見左右，行動與判斷只能靠隊形和標幟；它早於本役一千二百餘年，並不在采石與白土岡的戰場上，但它所代表的那條規律在開皇九年完全成立。實際登上戰場的裝備是另一套系統：隋軍以步騎為骨幹，步兵用環首刀、長矛與槊，騎兵披札甲、戴兜鍪，配弓箭與臂弩、腰弩等弩機，攻城另備巢車、櫓車、雲梯一類器械，並攜帶以火藥製成的燃燒箭與煙火具，用於焚燒舟艦與木柵；水軍方面造五牙大艦，上設樓觀三層，可居高臨下以矢石壓制城頭，另配黃龍、艅艎、舳艫、蒙衝等大小舟船，由廣陵順流直抵建康。陳軍的裝備重心在水上：大型樓船臨江布防，弓弩自高處連射，蒙衝小艇貼岸衝撞，岸上以木柵、藤牌護住步卒，蕭摩訶的精兵則是步騎混編，兼有江南水兵熟稔的操舟能力。運輸與補給是這一役最吃重的一環：五十餘萬大軍要靠糧船沿江北上，高頎在廣陵一線囤積積粟、徵發民夫，把糧秣一程程推送到軍前。裝備之別，最後落在同一件事上：隋軍的甲胄與馬匹可以讓隊形不散，陳軍的舟船與弩陣一旦失去統一號令，就只剩各自為戰的散兵。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on this card is the headgear of the Greek Bronze Age heavy infantry. It has a fully open face, it covers the head and both sides of the neck, and its field of view is narrow; the price of wearing it is that the wearer can barely see to left or right and can only act and judge by the shape of the line and by the standards. It predates this campaign by more than twelve centuries and was not on the field at Caishi or at the White Earth Ridge, but the rule it embodies held without qualification in the ninth year of Kaihuang. The equipment that actually went into battle belonged to a different system. Sui fielded infantry and cavalry as its backbone: foot soldiers carried ring-pommel sabres, long spears and long-handled spears, while cavalry wore lamellar armour and helmets and were armed with bows and with hand crossbows and waist crossbows; the assault train added siege towers, movable screens and scaling ladders, and carried fire arrows and smoke devices made from gunpowder for burning ships and palisades. On the water Sui built large five-tooth vessels with three tiers of superstructure, able to overwhelm the walls of a city with arrows and stones from above, and it also fielded yellow dragon ships, long swift galleys, transports and light skirmish boats of many sizes, all coming down the river from Guangling to Jiankang. Chen put the weight of its equipment on the water: great tower ships stood guard along the river, bows and crossbows fired in sequence from high positions, light rams ran in against the shore, and on land stakes and rattan shields covered the foot soldiers, while Xiao Mohe picked troops mixed foot and horse and carried the seamanship that southern river men possessed. Transport and supply were the heaviest part of the campaign. An army of more than half a million had to be fed by grain boats travelling up the river, and Gao Qiao concentrated surplus grain along the Guangling line, conscripted labour, and pushed the provisions forward stage by stage to the front. The difference in equipment came down to one thing at the end: Sui armour and horses allowed the line to hold together, whereas the ships and crossbow formations of Chen, once the unified command was lost, were only scattered soldiers fighting on their own.
tactics: 隋滅陳的戰術主軸是分進合擊與奇襲渡江。韓擒虎於正月初選精兵夜發，舟隊順流直趨采石，掩以火炬與夜色，待陳軍覺察，隋兵已登岸，陳軍舟師被衝散，守將杜彥兵敗身亡，長江西岸的門戶洞開。賀若弼一路走的是明處：據記載，他曾遣部將段煖挑戰，逼蕭摩訶不得不出，蕭摩訶按兵不動，賀若弼乃令弩手緣岸列陣，居高齊射，陳軍死傷相枕，陣腳先亂；繼而以精騎掩殺衝入缺口，陳軍大潰，蕭摩訶僅以身免。兩軍追奔至京口以西的白土岡，隋軍不待重整，連續攻擊陳軍新立之陣，逼其再度崩散，陳軍主力從此退守建康，與隋軍隔江相對。舟陸協同是整場戰役的另一條線：楊廣在廣陵以五牙大艦居中，黃龍、艅艎、舳艫相銜，舳艫塞江，旌旗蔽空，陳軍倚仗的城頭弩陣與江面水師在隋軍的舟艦與登岸步兵之間失去相互策應的空間。攻城時隋軍先以矢石與火箭壓制城頭，再用巢車、櫓車逼近城牆，步兵蟻附而上，各城相繼告陷。陳軍的問題不在裝備落後，而在節制失效：施文慶屢請遷都、備水軍迎敵而不得行，陳主深居宮中，國政委於左右，前線將領各自為戰，號令一到江邊便要走形。白土岡的具體地望，史書只略稱為江北岸的岡阜，一說在瓜步與京口之間，一說偏南近采石；本篇取瓜步至京口交界的沿江崗地立說，所標坐標為大略位置。
tacticsEn: The tactical spine of the Sui conquest of Chen was convergence by separate routes combined with a surprise crossing. Early in the first month Han Qinhu selected picked troops and marched by night, his flotilla running down the river against the current straight for Caishi, screened by torches and darkness. Only when the Chen forces noticed him were Sui soldiers already ashore, the Chen river fleet was scattered, the defending commander Du Yan was beaten and killed, and the western door of the Yangtze line was thrown open. He Ruobi took the obvious road in contrast. The records state that he sent one of his officers, Duan Xuan, forward to provoke an engagement and force Xiao Mohe to come out; Xiao Mohe held his troops in place, and He Ruobi thereupon massed his crossbowmen along the bank and fired from high ground, so that the Chen line was heaped with dead and wounded and its footing broke first. He then sent picked cavalry charging into the gap, and the Chen army collapsed, Xiao Mohe escaping with his life alone. The pursuit ran on to the White Earth Ridge west of Jingdu, where the Sui troops did not pause to reform but struck the newly formed Chen line again and broke it a second time, and from that point the main body of the Chen army fell back to Jiankang and faced the Sui across the river. Cooperation of fleet and army formed the other line of the whole campaign: at Guangling Yang Guang kept the great five-tooth vessels in the centre with yellow dragon ships, swift galleys and transports chained behind them, the transports plugging the river and banners blotting out the sky, and the Chen wall-mounted crossbows and river flotilla lost the room to support one another between the Sui warships and the Sui infantry that had landed. In the sieges the Sui first suppressed the walls with arrows, stones and fire arrows, then brought siege towers and movable screens up to the ramparts, the infantry climbing in like ants, and the cities fell one after another. The trouble with the Chen army was not backward equipment but the failure of command. Shi Wenqing petitioned again and again to move the capital and build up a fleet to meet the enemy, and his requests were refused; the Chen ruler stayed deep in the palace with state affairs in the hands of those around him, commanders on the front fought separately, and orders that reached the river bank immediately lost their shape. As for the exact position of the White Earth Ridge, the histories only call it a rise on the north bank, some placing it between Guabu and Jingdu and some placing it further south near Caishi; this account takes its ground to be the ridge country on the river bank at the junction of Guabu and Jingdu, and the coordinates given are approximate.
data: 可核的數字大致如下：隋文帝發兵五十餘萬伐陳，諸軍皆給六十日糧，軍行至江淮一線時糧秣已備；造舟艦二千餘艘，五牙大艦上設樓觀三層，自廣陵至建康的江面上舟船相接、亘延數百里；韓擒虎夜襲采石所部為精兵數千之眾，隋舟由上游順流而下，陳軍一覺即已失守；白土岡之役，隋軍斬首數千至萬餘級，陳軍屍橫數十里，蕭摩訶僅以身免。路程上，廣陵至建康的江程約二百五十公里，瓜步至京口約五十公里，采石至京口沿江約一百公里，賀若弼的推進正是沿這段北岸走廊逐點施壓。時間上，采石陷落在開皇九年正月，京口與白土岡之役緊接其後，二月隋軍入建康，陳朝覆亡，全役歷時約兩個月。以上數字多出自《隋書》與《資治通鑑》的零星記載，各書互有出入，確數已不可考；尤其傷亡與俘虜數，歷來多有誇飾，概從其略。至於兵員編制、糧秣總量與各路實際抵達戰場之人數，現存史料並無完整冊籍可查，僅能依行程與糧期反推其量級。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Emperor Wen of Sui sent more than half a million men against Chen, and every column was issued with sixty days of grain, so that by the time the army reached the river the supplies were already in place. More than two thousand boats and ships were built, and the great five-tooth vessels carried three tiers of superstructure, so that from Guangling to Jiankang the river was covered by hull after hull for tens of li. The force with which Han Qinhu struck Caishi by night was a picked body numbering some thousands, the Sui flotilla coming down with the current, and the Chen garrison had barely noticed before the position was lost. In the fight at the White Earth Ridge the Sui took several thousand to more than ten thousand heads, the Chen dead were said to lie for tens of li, and Xiao Mohe escaped with his life alone. As for distance, the river run from Guangling to Jiankang is about 250 kilometres, from Guabu to Jingdu about 50 kilometres, and from Caishi to Jingdu about 100 kilometres along the bank; He Ruobi advance worked along exactly that northern corridor, pressing point by point. In time, Caishi fell in the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang, the fighting at Jingdu and the White Earth Ridge followed immediately, and the Sui entered Jiankang in the second month, so the whole campaign lasted about two months. These numbers come mostly from scattered notices in the History of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror, the books differ from one another, and the exact figures cannot now be established; casualty and prisoner counts in particular were long exaggerated and are given here only in general terms. As for the order of battle, the total weight of provisions and the number of men from each axis who actually reached the battlefield, the surviving records contain no complete registers to consult, and the scale can only be inferred from the length of the marches and the length of the supply periods.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外一層是南北統一的形勢：北周在隋文帝手上被平定，關洛、中原盡歸一統，南方只剩陳朝一座江防，北強南弱之勢已定。陳朝內部早已自壞：宣帝陳頊病逝後，太子陳深與後主爭儲被誅，妃張氏遇害，連帶寵信張麗華；朝政又歸於施文慶、蔡大寶一班文臣手中，防務上的建議屢屢被拒，遷都避鋒、修造水軍、設險固守的主張都得不到後主支持。隋文帝看準的就是這個空檔：開皇八年底，他以晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，駐廣陵造舟、徵糧、操練水軍，同時令賀若弼、韓擒虎分道出兵，把南征準備做成一次長期工程，而不是一次倉促的冒險。陳朝君臣並非不知北方有兵，只是知道要打也來不及了：施文慶屢請陳主早作準備，得到的回應反是責其擾亂人心；等到隋軍真的渡江，才在倉促之中把主力壓到京口一線。於是這場戰爭從開始起就不是兩軍的對等較量，而是一場以整體國力、徵發能力與工程速度去壓垮一個已經內部失序的王朝的行動。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was the shape of a north that was being unified. The Northern Zhou had been destroyed in the hands of Emperor Wen of Sui, Guanlong and the central plain had come under one rule, and only the river defences of Chen stood between the south and a settled northern superiority. The inside of Chen had already rotted. After Emperor Xuan, Chen Xu, died, the crown prince Chen Shen was killed in the struggle with his brother for the succession, his consort of the Zhang clan was put to death, and out of that came the favour shown to Zhang Lihua. State affairs fell to a group of civil officials such as Shi Wenqing and Cai Dabao, and proposals on defence were refused again and again: moving the capital out of reach, building a river fleet, holding fortified positions in depth, none of them obtained the support of the ruler. What Emperor Wen had spotted was that opening. At the end of the eighth year of Kaihuang he set the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, as supreme commander, stationed at Guangling to build boats, gather grain and drill the river troops, and at the same time ordered He Ruobi and Han Qinhu to advance by separate roads, so that the preparation for the southern campaign became a long piece of engineering rather than a hurried gamble. The ministers of Chen were not unaware that troops stood in the north; they only knew that if a war did come it could not be prepared. Shi Wenqing petitioned the Chen ruler repeatedly to make ready in advance and was answered with reproach for disturbing the people. Only when the Sui really crossed the river did the state hurriedly throw its main body towards the line at Jingdu. From the outset, then, this was not a contest between two evenly matched armies, but an attempt to crush a dynasty that had already lost its internal order through the whole weight of a state's resources, its power of requisition and the speed of its engineering.
impact: 陳朝覆亡，終結了自西晉末以來近三百年的分裂格局，南北重新統一，隋朝取代北周與南陳，成為唐之前的第二個大一統王朝。這對中國歷史的影響是結構性的：江南自此脫離獨立王國的處境，士族門第與北方軍功集團在同一個王朝框架內重新編排，陳朝末年的宮廷、佛道、學術與文人群體被帶進北方；隋唐的制度底色——州縣制、三省制、科舉的雛形、從九品到科舉的過渡——正是在這一統之後的十幾年裡鋪開。人口與物資大規模北移，江淮的賦稅與漕運被納入全國性的財政體系，運河與糧運成為此後百年的國家工程。軍事的意義同樣具體：隋朝平陳之後，北方騎兵與江南水軍在同一支大軍裡第一次被編成一體，說明龐大的帝國可以靠制度把兩種地形的軍隊捏在一起，人才會有後來隋唐對北方草原的持續壓力。就卡面這件科林斯青銅盔而言，它提醒的是同一件事的另一面：開皇九年的勝負，表面看是舟船與騎兵之別，深處則是「戴盔者只能靠隊形活」的規律——隋軍之所以能把優勢變成追擊，是因為縱隊、旗幟與號令始終不散；陳軍不是輸在頭盔，而是輸在整支隊伍一旦離開節制便不再是一支軍隊。
impactEn: The fall of Chen ended close to three centuries of division dating from the late Western Jin, reunited north and south, and made the Sui the second great unifying dynasty before the Tang. The effect on Chinese history was structural. The south was now freed from the condition of a separate kingdom; the aristocratic lineages of the south and the military merit groups of the north were re-ordered inside a single dynastic framework; and the court culture, the Buddhist and Daoist establishments, the scholarship and the literary circles of late Chen were carried into the north. The institutional colouring of the Sui and Tang dynasties, the commandery and county system, the three departments, the embryo of the examination system, the transition from the nine-rank system towards examinations, was laid down in the decade or so after this unification. Population and goods moved north in bulk, the taxes and the grain transport of the Yangzi and Huai region were folded into a national financial system, and the canals and the grain fleets became the state works of the following centuries. The military meaning is just as concrete. After the conquest of Chen, northern cavalry and southern river troops were for the first time drawn into one army, which showed that a large empire could weld together armies from two different terrains through institutions, and only then did the sustained pressure of Sui and Tang on the northern steppes become possible. As for the Corinthian helmet on this card, it recalls the other side of the same truth. The outcome in the ninth year of Kaihuang looked at first like a difference between ships and cavalry, but at its depth lay the rule that the wearer of the helmet can live only by the line: the Sui were able to turn an advantage into pursuit because the columns, the banners and the orders never came apart, and Chen did not lose because of helmets but because a force that leaves its discipline stops being an army at all.
result: 白土岡之役以隋軍的完勝告終：陳軍自白土岡潰散，蕭摩訶僅以身免，陳朝在長江北岸最後一支能戰的精兵就此耗盡，隋軍隨即與韓擒虎部合勢，進逼京口、建康。正月之末、二月之間，隋軍各路破城：陳後主陳叔寶與張麗華、孔貴嬪匿身於建康臺城景陽殿的枯井中被搜出，陳朝正式覆亡，陳後主被檻送洛陽。蕭摩訶與其部眾隨後降隋，授開府儀同三司、封長壽縣公；杜彥戰歿於采石。隋朝平陳之後在江南改置州郡、重新編戶，以建康為丹陽郡置治，把新平之地納入均輸與屯田之制，江南自漢末以來第一次長期處於北方王朝的直接治理之下。平陳之功的分配很快在隋廷內部化為暗流：賀若弼以功高自恃而與晉王楊廣不協，最終開皇二十年為楊廣所忌而見殺；韓擒虎同樣被猜忌而抑鬱；這一段君臣相忌，正是隋朝短祚的原因之一，也預示了隋唐之際新一輪權力重整的到來。
resultEn: The fight at the White Earth Ridge ended in a complete Sui victory. The Chen troops broke up on the ridge, Xiao Mohe escaped with his life alone, and the last body of Chen soldiers capable of fighting on the north bank of the Yangtze was spent; the Sui then joined hands with Han Qinhu and pressed on Jingdu and Jiankang. Between the end of the first month and the second month the Sui columns took city after city. The last Chen emperor, Chen Shubao, together with Zhang Lihua and Kong Guiguin, was found hiding in the dry well of the Hall of Light and the Shade inside the imperial terraces at Jiankang; the Chen state was formally extinguished and the emperor was sent in a cage to Luoyang. Xiao Mohe and his men surrendered to Sui soon after and were granted the rank of minister of the palace and the title of Marquis of Longevity, while Du Yan had already fallen at Caishi. After the conquest the Sui reorganised the commanderies and prefectures of the south, re-registered the households, and made Jiankang the seat of Danyang prefecture, bringing the newly pacified country under the regular system of transport levies and military farms, so that the region south of the Yangzi for the first time since the late Han lay for long under the direct government of a northern dynasty. The distribution of the credit soon turned into a hidden current in the Sui court. He Ruobi, conscious of his great merit, did not get on with the Prince of Jin Yang Guang, and in the twentieth year of Kaihuang he was killed on the prince's jealousy; Han Qinhu likewise was suspected and grew bitter. This friction between ruler and ministers was one of the reasons the Sui dynasty lasted so short, and it foreshadowed the next redistribution of power in the Sui-Tang transition.
